claims.claim: A Utah State University physicist's analysis concluded the Wonder Valley data centre would release heat waste equivalent to twenty three atom bombs daily into northwestern Alberta boreal forest.
claims.episode_span: A Utah State University physicist conducted the review for the Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation and concluded the Wonder Valley data centre would release the equivalent of twenty three atom bombs of heat waste into the boreal forest of northwestern Alberta every day.
claims.source_title: Proposed data centre would release ‘23 Hiroshima-sized atomic bombs worth of energy’ a day, physicist says
claims.supporting_quote: An analysis of the mammoth Wonder Valley data centre suggests it would release the equivalent of 23 atom bombs of heat waste into the boreal forest of northwestern Alberta every day.

claims.claim: The Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation is seeking a full environmental impact assessment for the Wonder Valley data centre project.
claims.episode_span: The analysis states the project demands a full environmental impact assessment.
claims.source_title: Proposed data centre would release ‘23 Hiroshima-sized atomic bombs worth of energy’ a day, physicist says
claims.supporting_quote: A Utah State University physicist who conducted the review for the Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation said the project demands a full environmental impact assessment.
